mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 or coffee_table_l1 for morning. On Day 24, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 07:59 but moved to desk_o1 by 09:18. The location is highly volatile in the morning. Check desk_o1 for late morning (09:00-12:00) queries, as Tomas is working from home. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning (07:00-09:00). Do not assume coffee_table_l1.

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning. On Day 24, it was at desk_o1 at 09:59. This confirms that during work hours, the charger is likely at the desk. Check desk_o1 for late morning (09:00-12:00) queries. Keep checking nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and dining_table_d1 for early evening. On Day 24, it was at desk_o1 at 10:42 (late morning) and dining_table_d1 at 19:32 (early evening). The "mid-day" pattern of coffee_table_l1 is incorrect for late morning. Check desk_o1 for late morning (09:00-12:00) queries. Check dining_table_d1 for early evening (18:00-21:00) queries. Keep checking sink_k1 for late night (22:00+).

book_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning and bed_b1 for late night. No new evidence today to contradict this. Continue checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) queries. For late night (22:00+), check bed_b1 first.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night. On Day 25, it was at cupboard_k1 at 22:59. The assumption that it stays on the nightstand overnight is incorrect. Check cupboard_k1 for late night (22:00+) queries.
